claims.content: To create and edit auction event profiles that provide a common set of characteristics to a group of products, making scheduling groups of product easier and faster, providing consistency, and reducing data entry errors.

goal.raw_text: To create and edit auction event profiles that provide a common set of characteristics to a group of products, making scheduling groups of product easier and faster, providing consistency, and reducing data entry errors.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged in and has accessed the Auction Administration page.
The Auctioneer wishes to create a new promotional event or edit an existing profile.
The Auctioneer accesses the Auction Event Profiles Page to create a new promotional event or edit an existing profile.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer accesses the Auction Event Profiles Page to create a new promotional event or edit an existing profile.

claims.content: The Auctioneer accesses the Auction Event Profiles Page.
To create a new profile, the Auctioneer tabs or clicks into the “Create New Profile” field and enters a new profile name, then clicks on “Create.”

The Auctioneer fills in the 2nd column, which is always the upper range of the cost tier. The system automatically fills in the lower range of the subsequent cost tier by adding $0.01 to the last value entered by the auctioneer, until all fields are completed.
Working horizontally and adjacent to each cost tier, the Auctioneer chooses a radio button for either “amount” or “% of cost”, and fills in the appropriate field.
Any % of cost values under 100% automatically appear in BOLD RED as a warning to the Auctioneer. This does not prevent the Auctioneer from proceeding.
The Auctioneer designates a bid increment for all items in the cost tier.
The Auctioneer designates an auction duration to all items within the cost tier.
The Auctioneer chooses one of the radio buttons at the bottom to specify what products will be eligible to use the profile (e.g., “Apply to Gemstones Only”).
The Auctioneer finishes profile creation by clicking on the “Apply” button.

To edit an existing profile, the Auctioneer accesses the page and chooses the profile she wishes to edit from the list. Once she clicks on the profile name, the previously-entered data is displayed for modification.

If the Auctioneer tries to apply a profile to a grouping of jewelry items after selecting 'Apply to Gemstones Only', the system generates an error message stating that this profile can only be applied to products in the gemstone category.
The system provides a warning, preferably via a popup window, if any of the items being scheduled have additional quantities of the same item already scheduled in overlapping auction events.

If the Auctioneer chooses 'Apply to Gemstones Only' and later tries to apply the profile to a grouping of jewelry items, the system will generate an error message telling her that this profile can only be applied to products in the gemstone category (retail category = gemstones).

A new auction event profile has been created or an existing profile has been edited with validated parameters including profile name, cost tier values, opening bid amounts, bid increments, and auction durations.

The system enforces category restrictions on application of the profile; if a profile is designated for a specific product category (e.g., gemstones), it can only be applied to products in that category.
Profile creation or editing is completed successfully upon clicking the 'Apply' button.
